Joined overhead arm loops produce trophy/tree and raised-arm readings. Head is not isolated; celebration/surrender objection persists.
Dynamic running/falling silhouette reads action but not definite fear/loss of initiative. Head/arm merge preserves dancing/fleeing ambiguity.
